# Vendored Remote Execution API & Google APIs Protos

Minimal `.proto` subset required to compile REAPI v2 (`build.bazel.remote.execution.v2`,
`build.bazel.semver`), `google.bytestream`, `google.longrunning`, `google.rpc`, and
`leadingterm.gang.worker.v1` with `gang-protogen`.
